notes.title: 2018.04.15 Zazmo Arcade Weekly Update
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to the weekly Zazmo Weekend update! [/b]

Let’s get rolling with the news and then share some of the latest development videos. 

[b]Boss 101 and Zazmo[/b]

Though this is not a Boss 101 update we do need to talk a little about what the development team has been working on for the last week. Our team is three people and we are working on both the Zazmo Arcade as well as the Boss 101 port to the Xbox One. Well, it looks like the Xbox One port is about done. We had a few minor bugs and issues to address this week and ideally we will have great news for all our friends and fans in the next big update. 

[b]Zazmo Arcade Pack 2 [/b]

With the wrap-up of Boss 101 we will be doing two things. The first will be finishing up the Early Access for the Zazmo Arcade Pack 1 (ZAP1) and then moving onto the Zazmo Arcade Pack 2 – which is tentatively being internally billed as a Sports or Action pack. We don’t know exactly what games will be in it but we are looking at putting in games like car racing, golf and maybe some form of football (North American or world themed).

We’ll keep you posted as we go but you can bet we want to make this amazing and fun so expect some fun twists on the standard sports fare.

[b]Game Development Blogs[/b]

Game Dev Night 07
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gtS5CleSazM
Game Dev Night 08
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vU0VI9GGWVM
Check out the two weekly blogs we put up. Both have lots of dev talk. We also look at older games and the designs they have to see how much can still be applied to today. Some really nice work went into the classics and we try to break it down. 

Talk with you soon and remember to LIVE YOUR DREAMS!

-Tim

[b]Zazmo Arcade Pack Info Roundup[/b]
[b]Twitch Channel - Monday Thursday Dev Streams at 6pm CST [/b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/donleytime/]Donley Time Twitch[/url]

notes.title: 2018.04.08 Zazmo Weekly Update
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to the weekly Zazmo Arcade Update[/b]

We have a bit of a shorter update this week. All three of us are concentrated on getting our other game Boss 101 through submissions at Microsoft. On that end we are in the home stretch and that means a bit of bug fixing and adjustments to the build for the Xbox One. Thankfully nothing we can’t handle but it is taking our focus. 

Onwards and upwards!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dUn7eHu.gif[/img]

On the Zazmo end, I did this week’s game night and development update. Looked at some of the older classics we have been inspired from. It’s interesting to see how these game which are closing in on 30 years old hold up. 

Game Development Dev Talk with Zazmo, looking at older game designs
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Eh15SuJMWuU

Checked out the sequel to a game called Rush N Attack and man – that thing is a quarter muncher. You die so often and the game is so brutal!

Also did a run through Bionic Commando. It’s hard to overstate the great ideas in that game and how far they permeate into many other games. Really fun still but also a really hard game to just get through without dying a lot! I mean a lot.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/S2Bg07p.gif[/img]

On the strictly Zazmo front we are looking to wrap up development and leave Early Access once we are done with Boss 101 on the Xbox One. As we have said – there are not a lot of things on the main list left. We are mostly looking at polishing things and adjusting gameplay bits. All the core gameplay tenets are there and we are focused on making the whole things smooth and easy to play.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Yzn6uaa.gif[/img]

Personally I am pretty excited about the new powerups for the games Breakdown and Rob’s Adventure. They add a lot to already fun games and bring the whole experience up a notch or two.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EgpZbHI.gif[/img]

OK, check out the video and we will talk with you soon!

Remember to always – LIVE YOUR DREAMS!

-Tim

[b]Zazmo Arcade Pack Info Roundup[/b]
[b]Twitch Channel - Monday Thursday Dev Streams at 6pm CST [/b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/donleytime/]Donley Time Twitch[/url]

notes.title: 2018.03.11 Zazmo Weekly Update - Programming and Tunes
notes.content:
[b]Hello and welcome back to the latest Zazmo Arcade Pack update![/b]

[b]Game testing and tuning continue[/b]

We have a few new things to drop in your lap this week. We are working on the achievements for the game and have an art set for the high score awards to show. Check out the image below. It represents some of the medals we will be awarding for various games and high scores in those games. The idea is to keep a base look and have some sort of tier (or star) system to represent higher and harder achievements. 

I know the whole star thing gets used a lot but it is a really good way to show things progressing. Well, that and trophies. Haha

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GjbxFnP.png[/img]

[b]Game and Development Twitch Streams Continue[/b]

Episode 3 of the Clueless Programmer went off this week. Check out Joshua teaching time all about ways to code movement of your characters and objects with the gamepad.  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-LSyO1ChBiA
We cover a lot of interesting (well, to me at least) ways that Zazmo is setup. Joshua walks me through a lot of his thinking as a programmer and overall – I learned something! Haha

[b]Game Development Dev Talks and Game Night[/b]

Joshua and I sat down and played some old arcade games, including the ones that inspired the Zazmo arcade (specifically Rip-Off). We explore co-op games to find what is working and why!

Check out Episode 2 and 3 below. Lots of fun laughs and good times.

[b]Episode 2[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TJox0YClImY
[b]Episode 3 – playing Cadillacs and Dinosaurs[/b]

We find out freaking a BLANKA look alike is in this game!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ej9_Dz41e54
Ok – more to come and don’t forget we will be coming to the Xbox One too!! YEAH BUDDY!

Thank you again for all your support and talk with you soon. Remember to always – LIVE YOUR DREAMS!

-Tim

[b]Zazmo Arcade Pack Info Roundup[/b]
[b]Twitch Channel - Monday Thursday Dev Streams at 6pm CST [/b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/donleytime/]Donley Time Twitch[/url]
[i]We appreciate your continued support![/i]

notes.title: 2018.02.10 Game Dev Saturday Update and Screenshots
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/EgpZbHI.gif[/img]

Hello all and welcome to the weekly Zazmo Update!

Let’s get rolling shall we? We have a bunch of things to show you and it starts with the newest trailer for the Zazmo Arcade Pack! Check it out!

[b]New Zazmo Trailer![/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DIvYHYsie9U

Curious about how the game looks in action? Well, we also have gameplay snippets from our games included along with THE DEVS TALKING! You know you’re curious. Check out the Thursday Night Twitch Stream here!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ElHgDnFcxew

[b]This week[/b]

A lot of this week has been about improving the various gameplay experiences in Zazmo. We added tunes to the Last Stand controls and touched-up the overall gameplay. Did you know we added in asteroids to spice things up? Yep, check it out!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XiwAVbm.gif[/img]

There is a more control work to be done with the ships in this one. Personally, I think they are coming along well but I’d love to see a little more responsiveness in the turns. That’s on the table at the moment and we’ll keep you posted on our progress.

[b]Tank Wars![/b]

As we spoke about before, we have shootable bullets in Tank Wars now. It’s a really fun option and we have been playing around with it. Creates a lot of fun experiences and player options during battle. It looks like we are maxxed out on Tank Wars options. Haha. We’d really love to add more but we have to keep all the games on a somewhat even keel as we go forward. Still – Tank Wars is one of my (Tim) personal favs of the batch.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Pf1TSRg.gif[/img]

[b]Tank Wars Maps - some map samples[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/q6cx9LJ.gif[/img]

[b]Mazard Map Samples[/b]

We have some maps to show you for Mazard as well! Been playing a lot of Mazard and it’s hard to pick which one is my fav. They all have some great stuff in them!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AfdqWeV.gif[/img]

More to come and talk with you soon. Please join us for the live streams on Monday and Thursday! We play games and give away keys to viewers. We would love to see you there and answer question if you have any!

Thank you again and remember to [b]LIVE YOUR DREAMS![/b]

-Tim

notes.title: 2018.02.03 Zazmo, 5 games in 1 Arcade Pack Update
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/m8zS6qz.gif[/img]

[b]Hello and welcome back to the latest Zazmo Arcade update![/b]

We had a busy week with updates and game tunes so let's get rolling!

Let's start strong with Thursday's video of our Twitch gameplay session. Are you watching these live? You should! We give out free Steam keys to the Zazmo arcade and say arguably interesting things!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-GyzfCqfFjQ

[b]Mazard[/b]

We added in the art for the Mazard bomb! If you sit still for too long you will be bombed by the Mazard himself. You have a few moments to get out of the way. One interesting thing is the bomb will take out enemies as well as players so maybe there is some strategic use for high level players.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UOdB0H3.gif[/img]

[b]Tank Wars[/b]

Shootable bullets as an option? YOU GOT IT! Now you can use your skillage to rock foolios when you shoot THEIR bullets. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/m8zS6qz.gif[/img]

[b]Last Stand[/b]

We're continuing to work on the AI and looking at adding in a few new variables for you to set at the start of each game. We added a few tweaks to the controls to give the ships more of a spaceship feel too!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VikrPm9.gif[/img]


We also started adding in more details for the end of the round panels. Here you can see the player's icon on the panel. We are looking at giving the user some control over these for some end of round antics.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/yBTUgon.gif[/img]

[b]Rob's Adventure[/b]

Man, there is a lot going on here and we have a little more to do. We want to add in more options as we go. At the moment the game is looking to have more patterns and even some power ups. We're open to ideas so drop us a line!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Yzn6uaa.gif[/img]

Ok - that's all for this week and talk with you soon! 

Remember to always - LIVE YOUR DREAMS!

-Tim

[b]Estimated Ship, 1st Quarter 2018[/b]

[i]Please wishlist us on the Steam Store if you would be so kind![/i]
